topview_scene_intake.rule: Scene ID is the creative scene; task ID is one render/slot. Capacity is 6 active task IDs. Canonical slow_scenes stays unique by Scene ID, while the Control Center shows one row per active task/slot.

note: 7/7 canonical Drive instruction files exact-match GitHub. Certificate refreshed by Recovery after fresh Drive/GitHub comparison; stale certificate age alone is maintenance freshness, not master-sync failure.

recovery_sync.note: Daily deep audit runs inside hourly Recovery when due; Topview Scene Intake & Slow Watch remains separate at HH:00.

slow_table_ui.rule: All three user-facing views render from one normalized topview-status active_tasks snapshot. Revision shows unique scenes/tasks, Topview table is one row per task, active-scene map is one row per Scene with multiplicity. Queue/status values must never come from independent caches.

primary_watcher.title: Topview Scene Intake & Slow Watch
primary_watcher.connector_degradation_behavior: never self-disable; preserve last verified snapshot and retry next HH:00

topview_liveness.owner_experience: set-and-forget; deterministic drift repaired automatically where authority/tools are actually available

three_view_topview_contract.summary_cardinality: unique Scene IDs plus explicit active-task multiplicity
three_view_topview_contract.scene_map_cardinality: one row per unique active Scene ID with aggregated live status
required_equalities: unique(active_tasks.scene_id) == project-status.slow_scenes == canonical slow Scene IDs
occupied_slots == len(active_tasks) == Topview table row count
per-scene multiplicity == count(active_tasks for that scene)

automation_schedule.one_writer_note: Topview watcher remains primary writer. Recovery runs five minutes later so it can observe and repair a completed/failed watcher cycle instead of racing it.

library_recovery.owner_interruption_policy: do_not_prompt_owner_for_routine_library_overwrite; skip and mark pending/stale if interactive consent is required
library_recovery.truth_rule: Never claim Library current without successful write/read-back; authoritative layers remain Drive/GitHub; Notion remains operational/story pointer.
